Francisco Gold Condominium II, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City Telephone Number 925.11.48 • 925_88.88 • 925.03.32 www.dilg.gov.ph OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG Legal Opinion No. 13, S. 2013 1 8 APR 2013 DIR. JOSEFINA E. CASTILLA GO DILG-Region IV-A FTI Complex, Taguig City Dear Dir. Castilla-GO: This has reference to your Memorandum dated 04 April 2013 indorsing to the Central Office the letter dated 22 March 2013 of Mr. Florencio B. Quicoy, Jr., Head, Landbank of the Philippines, Antipolo Branch, requesting advice on whether the Decision dated 13 March 2013 rendered by the Office of the President dismissing the Appeal of Punong Barangay Andrei J. Zapanta in OP-DC Case No. 13-A-()04 entitled "Atty. Andrei J. Zapanta vs. Joselito R. Garcia, et al." is sufficient for them to recognize Mr. Crisol L. Cate as Acting Punong Barangay of San Luis, Antipolo City. In reply thereto, we are of the view that the aforesaid OP Decision is not a sufficient basis for the recognition of Mr. Crisol L. Cate as Acting Punong Barangay of San Luis, Antipolo City. It may be recalled that the Department's Legal Opinion has presumed the validity of Antipolo City Ordinance No. 94-2001 anent the enforceability of the Decision dated 02 January 2013 of the Sangguniang Panlungsod which imposed upon PB Zapanta the penalty of suspension for six (6) months. Accordingly, the SP Decision should comply with the fifteen (15)-day period provided in the aforesaid City Ordinance. Unfortunately, however, the election period has already commenced within the 15-day period provided by the City Ordinance for the enforceability of the SP Decision. As provided in COMELEC Resolution No. 93851, the election period started last 13 January 2013 and lasts until 12 June 2013. Let it be noted that one of the prohibited acts2 during election period is suspension of local elective officials. Calendar of Activities and Periods of Certain Prohibited Acts in Connection with the May 13, 2013 National and Local Elections. Section 261 BP No. 881 Suspension of elective provincial, city, municipal or barangay officer. - The provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding during the election period, any public official who suspends, without prior approval of the Commission. any elective provincial, city, municipal or barangay officer, unless said suspension will be for purposes of applying the "Anvi-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act" in relation to the suspension and removal of elective officials; in which case Lhe provisions Of this section shall be inapplicable.

Furthermore, when the Office of the President rendered its Decision dismissing the appeal of PB Zapanta on 13 March 2013, the election period is still in effect. In view of the foregoing and pursuant to Section 261(x) of the Omnibus Election Code, before the suspension against PB Zapanta is implemented (which will necessarily pave the way for the application of the rule of succession), the COMELEC's approval must first be sought. Thus, in the absence of any showing that a COMELEC approval had been issued vis-å-vis PB Zapanta's suspension, we are of the view that it is still premature to apply the rule of succession and thus recognize the first-ranking sangguniang barangay member, Mr. Crisol Cate, as Acting Punong Barangay. We hope to have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, AUSTE A. PANADERO Undersecretary 1-8/17 Copy furnished: MR. FLORENCIO B. QUICOY, JR.
